svg.title: Candy Galaxy layout
svg.text: CANDY GALAXY · Candy Galaxy · 96x60 tiles · road 5.5 tiles wide
Lap 244 tiles = 31,179 px · about 37 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 10.7 tiles
Glowing path = star lane (full speed). Starry space = dust (slower). Clouds / moon = slowest. Pale stretch = slippery ice.
Beacons light the tight bends. Grey rocks on dashes = drifting asteroids. Yellow streak = comet path. Orange = boost. Rock ring = wall.
Gold dashes = Gumball Gap: 25 tiles, 2.8 wide, instead of 31 tiles of main lane
Gold dashes = Sugar Rush: 28 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 30 tiles of main lane
